documents.title: Agent Instructions
documents.lead: Concise mandatory rules and the task-based reading map for agents.
documents.policy: Update when mandatory operating rules or reading requirements change.

documents.title: Agent 工作规则
documents.lead: Agent 必须遵守的简明规则与按任务读取地图。
documents.policy: 强制工作规则或读取要求变化后更新。

documents.title: Start Here
documents.lead: Purpose, evidence priority, reading order, and maintenance triggers.
documents.policy: Update when the entry point, reading map, or maintenance protocol changes.

documents.title: 从这里开始
documents.lead: 用途、证据优先级、读取顺序与维护触发条件。
documents.policy: 入口、读取地图或维护协议变化后更新。

documents.title: Project Goal
documents.lead: Durable objective, current milestone, success criteria, and non-goals.
documents.policy: Update only after the user changes the durable project objective.

documents.title: 项目目标
documents.lead: 长期目标、当前里程碑、成功标准与非目标。
documents.policy: 只有用户改变长期项目目标时更新。

documents.title: Project Constraints
documents.lead: Confirmed cross-project boundaries, quality rules, and open assumptions.
documents.policy: Update when the user accepts, changes, or retires a durable constraint.

documents.title: 项目约束
documents.lead: 已确认的通用边界、质量规则与待确认假设。
documents.policy: 用户确认、修改或退役长期约束时更新。

documents.title: Current Valid Files
documents.lead: Authoritative entry points, configurations, artifacts, and validity boundaries.
documents.policy: Update when an authoritative path, branch, configuration, or artifact changes.

documents.title: 当前有效文件
documents.lead: 权威入口、配置、产物与有效性边界。
documents.policy: 权威路径、分支、配置或产物变化后更新。

documents.title: Current Version Notes
documents.lead: Current deliverables, behavior, structure, interfaces, dependencies, and known gaps.
documents.policy: Update after a deliverable, behavior, structure, interface, dependency, or procedure change.

documents.title: 当前版本说明
documents.lead: 当前交付物、行为、结构、接口、依赖与已知缺口。
documents.policy: 交付物、行为、结构、接口、依赖或流程变化后更新。

documents.title: Current Tasks
documents.lead: Active work, ownership, status, acceptance, blockers, and handoff state.
documents.policy: Update when a task is declared, completed, blocked, resumed, or changes scope.

documents.title: 当前任务清单
documents.lead: 当前工作、负责人、状态、验收、阻塞与交接信息。
documents.policy: 任务被声明、完成、阻塞、恢复或改变范围时更新。

documents.title: Decisions
documents.lead: Accepted, retired, and reversed durable choices with rationale.
documents.policy: Update when a durable choice is accepted, retired, or reversed.

documents.title: 历史决策
documents.lead: 已确认、已退役与已反转的长期选择及理由。
documents.policy: 长期选择被确认、退役或反转时更新。

documents.title: Project History
documents.lead: Events that changed the interpretation or direction of the project.
documents.policy: Update when an event changes how past or current work should be understood.

documents.title: 项目历史
documents.lead: 改变项目理解或方向的重要事件。
documents.policy: 事件改变历史或当前工作的解释时更新。

documents.title: Next Directions
documents.lead: Plausible future work that is not yet an active commitment.
documents.policy: Update when a plausible direction appears, changes, becomes active, or is retired.

documents.title: 后续方向
documents.lead: 尚未成为当前承诺的合理后续工作。
documents.policy: 合理方向出现、变化、转为当前工作或退役时更新。

documents.title: Reference Materials
documents.lead: Retained source material, provenance, relevance, and review status.
documents.policy: Update when a retained source or its provenance, relevance, or status changes.

documents.title: 参考材料
documents.lead: 保留材料的来源、用途、相关性与审阅状态。
documents.policy: 保留材料或其来源、相关性、状态变化时更新。

documents.title: Archive Guide
documents.lead: Retention, inactive-state labels, traceability, and restoration rules.
documents.policy: Update when archive structure, retention, or restoration guidance changes.

documents.title: 存档说明
documents.lead: 保留、非活动状态、追溯与恢复规则。
documents.policy: 存档结构、保留或恢复规则变化时更新。
